collect_ai:wecruit.hotjob.cn:6a46aa7dad3.description:
1、负责AI应用架构规划与技术路线 。结合业务目标，梳理研发、营销、运营、管理等场景的智能化需求，制定 AI 应用总体架构、技术路线、平台能力规划和实施路径；
2、负责大模型、RAG、Agent、工作流、知识库、数据与接口集成等关键能力的技术选型与标准沉淀；
3、 AI应用方案设计与核心交付 。主导重点 AI 应用从需求分析、原型验证、方案设计到上线交付；
4、负责核心链路、系统架构、数据流、调用链、Prompt/Agent 流程、评测机制和异常处理策略设计；负责协调产品、业务、研发及测试资源，推动场景从 0 到 1 落地。；
5、负责系统集成、工程治理与安全合规。负责 AI 应用与现有业务系统、数据平台、权限体系、流程工具的集成设计，建立 API、数据、日志、监控、性能、成本和版本管理规范；推进模型输出质量、权限隔离、数据安全、内容安全、稳定性与上线评审等治理机制；
6、负责技术赋能、供应商协同与持续优化。面向业务团队和研发团队沉淀 AI 应用方法论、组件模板和最佳实践，开展方案评审、技术培训和落地辅导；
7、负责管理外部供应商或平台资源，跟踪新技术趋势和应用效果，持续优化系统体验、交付效率和业务价值。
collect_ai:wecruit.hotjob.cn:6a46aa7dad3.requirements:
1、本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、人工智能、自动化、信息管理等相关专业优先。
2、5年以上软件研发、系统架构、数字化平台或AI应用建设相关经验，具备2年以上大模型应用、智能体、知识库、RAG或企业AI项目落地经验；有制造业、家电行业、研发管理、营销运营、供应链或企业内部数字化系统建设经验者优先。
3、熟悉大模型应用架构、RAG、Agent、Prompt工程、知识库、向量检索、工作流编排、模型评测和AI应用工程化方法；理解企业级系统架构、数据治理、权限体系、接口集成、安全合规、性能稳定性和成本治理要求。
4、具备独立完成需求分析、技术方案设计、架构图输出、接口设计、系统集成、项目推进和上线交付的能力；熟悉Python、Java、Node.js等至少一种开发语言，了解数据库、API、容器化、云服务、日志监控、CI/CD等工程能力；能与产品、业务、研发、测试和供应商高效协同。
5、具备较强的业务理解、抽象建模、跨团队沟通和项目推动能力，能够将复杂AI技术转化为可落地的业务方案；具备结果导向、 owner意识和持续学习能力，能够在不确定场景下推进问题闭环。
6、关注AI技术趋势和企业应用实践，具备较强的信息安全、数据安全和合规意识；有AI中台、智能客服、智能知识库、企业智能体、流程自动化、研发效能工具等项目经验者优先。

collect_ai:wecruit.hotjob.cn:6a8a7a421ad.description:
1. 负责AI Agent智能体的基础训练、微调、迭代优化工作，协助搭建Agent感知、决策、执行全流程训练体系，保障智能体任务执行的稳定性与准确性；
2. 参与Agent训练数据集的整理、清洗、标注、扩充工作，针对对话交互、任务拆解、工具调用等Agent核心能力，优化训练数据质量，剔除无效、噪声数据，构建标准化训练素材库；
3. 跟进AI Agent训练全流程，记录训练参数、训练日志，分析训练过程中的问题，针对智能体回答偏差、任务执行失败、逻辑混乱、多轮对话断层等问题，配合算法团队优化训练策略；
4. 协助完成Agent智能体的场景化落地测试，覆盖办公协作、智能问答、自动化任务处理等应用场景，输出训练测试报告、问题复盘报告，持续迭代优化Agent性能；
5. 学习并跟进主流Agent技术框架（如AutoGPT、LangChain、LlamaIndex等），整理技术文档、训练规范、操作手册，沉淀标准化的AI Agent训练流程与方法论；
6. 配合产品、算法、研发团队，落地Agent功能迭代需求，完成新功能、新能力的专项训练与适配调试，保障产品迭代效率。
collect_ai:wecruit.hotjob.cn:6a8a7a421ad.requirements:
1. 具备扎实的人工智能、机器学习基础理论知识，了解大语言模型、生成式AI基本原理，对AI Agent智能体技术有清晰认知，了解Agent自主决策、工具调用、记忆机制、任务拆解等核心能力逻辑；
2. 熟悉至少一种主流Agent框架或大模型微调工具，了解LangChain、AutoGPT等框架的基础使用逻辑，掌握基础的Prompt工程，能够独立编写、优化Agent任务提示词；
3. 掌握Python基础语法，能够完成简单的数据处理、脚本调试工作，可辅助完成训练数据批量处理、模型微调辅助工作；
4. 具备基础的数据标注、数据清洗能力，了解AI模型训练、测试的基本流程和评价指标，能够精准识别Agent运行过程中的各类问题；
5. 具备基本的技术文档撰写能力，可清晰梳理训练流程、问题细节、优化方案，输出标准化报告。

5.	数据飞轮与自动驾驶： 搭建数据闭环系统（Data Loop），利用测试家庭反馈进行模型 SFT（精调）与 RLHF，提升机器人的个性化记忆与长线陪伴能力。
6.	安全与隐私架构： 设计端侧边缘计算方案，确保儿童视频/语音数据的绝对隐私安全，符合全球最严苛的合规标准。

4.	全栈技术栈： * 精通 Python/C++，熟悉 PyTorch/TensorFlow 框架； 
o	熟悉常用语音处理流程（STT/TTS/NLP）；
o	熟悉计算机视觉常见任务（人脸/骨骼/行为/物体识别）。
5.	系统工程思维： 具备深厚的分布式系统、中间件或实时通信（RTC）架构经验，能解决 AI 模块与其他硬件控制模块的协同开销问题。

collect_global:jobs.ashbyhq.com:ashby--t.full_text:
BUILD SOMETHING MONUMENTAL FOR HEALTHCARE!




At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an experienced and passionate AI Engineer to join us in building a cutting-edge, LLM-centered application that will transform the healthcare experience in Europe. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced AI, intuitive design, and real-world impact — all in a fast-paced startup environment where the best ideas win. You'll be part of a world-class team shaping the future of healthcare delivery with powerful, production-grade LLM technology.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Design and build a full-stack, LLM-driven application — from intuitive UI to seamless backend model integration

 - Monitor and improve a highly utilized LLM application already in production

 - Iterate quickly to incorporate the latest advancements in LLMs, infrastructure, and user feedback into the product

 - Own the end-to-end delivery of features and solutions, from idea to deployment

 - Work cross-functionally with product, design, and engineering to drive real user outcomes
   


WHAT YOU BRING

 - A strong background in AI engineering, especially with LLM-centric products

 - Proven experience shipping production-grade applications, ideally in fast-paced or startup environments

 - A bias toward action, comfort with ambiguity, and a passion for tackling complex problems

 - A collaborative spirit — you're excited to work with top-tier teammates and contribute to a culture where the best ideas thrive

 - Experience with our core stack: Python, TypeScript, React, Kubernetes

 - Motivation to help reshape European healthcare, and enjoy the journey while doing it




BONUS POINTS

 - Familiarity with Microsoft-based infrastructure: C# for Windows apps, Azure for cloud hosting

 - Hands-on experience using or integrating LLMs like GPT or speech models like Whisper

 - Prior work in healthcare tech or regulated environments
   
   
   


LOCATION

We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This role is based in our vibrant HQ in the Epicenter building in the heart of Stockholm where you will work primarily from our office to collaborate, connect, and build our culture. 




HOW TO APPLY

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

 1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition 

 2. Technical interviews with some of our Engineering team 

 3. System Design Interview at our office - Join us in the Stockholm office for a lunch and a Product focused System Design interview to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

 4. Follow-up interview with our CTO & Co-Founder 



BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary & company stock options

 - 30 days/year of paid vacation

 - 5,000 SEK wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag) plus an additional 6,000 SEK yearly to spend on other health related initiatives

 - Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents

 - Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy

 - Mental health support through our partner Mindler

 - Pension program

 - Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)

 - An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare

 - Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.

We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.




CULTURE AT TANDEM


At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

collect_global:jobs.ashbyhq.com:ashby--u.requirements:
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
We are looking for a self-directed engineer who excels in high-stakes, ambiguous environments. You are likely a strong fit if your professional background reflects the following:
- Systems-First Engineering: You prioritize building reliable, scalable systems over experimental scripts. You have a track record of moving AI models out of notebooks and into production environments where latency, cost, and accuracy are treated as first-class citizens.
- Technical Resourcefulness: You are comfortable working in restricted or air-gapped environments. When commercial APIs aren’t an option, you have the expertise to deploy, fine-tune, and optimize open-source models to achieve the mission objective.
- Autonomous Problem Solving: You can take a high-level government requirement and translate it into a technical roadmap. You don't require constant oversight to identify the right tool for a job, whether it’s a specific vector database or a custom multimodal pipeline.
- A "Generalist" Mindset: While you specialize in AI, you understand the full stack. You are as comfortable discussing embedding strategies as you are configuring AWS GovCloud infrastructure or debugging a FastAPI endpoint.
MUST-HAVES
- Proven experience deploying Production RAG pipelines against real-world, messy datasets.
- Deep expertise in Agentic system design (tool-use, multi-agent orchestration).
- Strong Python engineering skills—writing clean, scalable, and maintainable code
- Experience operating within AWS/GovCloud environments.
NICE-TO-HAVES
- Experience fine-tuning NLP or object detection models.
- Familiarity with LLM evaluation frameworks (hallucination detection, drift monitoring).
- Knowledge of government security standards and working in different classification environments and on-prem
- Security Clearance: Existing Secret/TS clearance or eligibility is a significant plus.
YOUR TECHNICAL TOOLKIT
- Languages: Python (expert-level), SQL
- LLM & Agentic Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar orchestration frameworks
- RAG Stack: Retrieval with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector), graph databases (Neo4J), Elasticsearch, BM25, and Sentence-Transformers; NLP enrichment with spaCy, GLiNER, and Transformers; optimization using embedding models, reranking pipelines, and DSPy
- Evaluation & Observability: RAGAS, DeepEval, Arize Phoenix, and synthetic annotations
- Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, SageMaker, Bedrock, S3, Lambda, Docker, and FastAPI
- Data Processing: Complex pipelines for unstructured and multimodal data, including PDFs, scanned documents, images, and audio.
collect_global:jobs.ashbyhq.com:ashby--u.full_text:
Unstructured is defining the standard for enterprise data transformation in the age of LLMs and generative AI. In just two years, we've raised over $65M from world-class investors, including Menlo Ventures, Bain Capital, Databricks, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and IBM.

 

Our open-source toolkit has been downloaded 97M+ times and is used by 90% of the Fortune 1000. We power production AI workflows across commercial and federal sectors — transforming PDFs, HTML, Word docs, images, emails, and more into AI-ready data pipelines that scale.

 

We're not just building tools; we're building the backbone of generative AI and the infrastructure that unlocks intelligence across industries.







THE MISSION



At Unstructured, we are obsessed with transforming messy, unstructured data into a format that LLMs can actually use. Our Public Sector team has recently secured several high-impact contracts that demand more than just "off-the-shelf" solutions. We are looking for an AI Engineer who thrives at the intersection of R&D and production-grade software engineering.

 

You won’t just be building notebook demos; you will be architecting, prototyping, and shipping novel multimodal data processing, RAG, and agentic systems that solve critical problems for Government and Military clients. Your work will bridge the gap between one-off custom builds and a repeatable, scalable product roadmap.



 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN & DRIVE



 - You will be a high-agency individual contributor, owning the lifecycle of AI solutions from initial research to AWS deployment.

 

 - 50% Building & Shipping: Design and implement production-grade RAG pipelines and agentic workflows using Python. You’ll build systems that handle real-world "messy" data (PDFs, scanned docs, images, full motion video) and ensure they are performant and scalable.

 

 - 30% Research & Experimentation: Stay at the bleeding edge. You’ll evaluate new models (LLMs, embedding models, object detection), prototype approaches for SBIR/government deliverables, and run experiments to prove what actually works.

 

 - 20% Strategy & Collaboration: Partner with the team to document architectures, contribute to technical reports for contract deliverables, and participate in pre-sales calls to architect solutions for complex client needs.
   
   

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 



We are looking for a self-directed engineer who excels in high-stakes, ambiguous environments. You are likely a strong fit if your professional background reflects the following:

 

 - Systems-First Engineering: You prioritize building reliable, scalable systems over experimental scripts. You have a track record of moving AI models out of notebooks and into production environments where latency, cost, and accuracy are treated as first-class citizens.

 

 - Technical Resourcefulness: You are comfortable working in restricted or air-gapped environments. When commercial APIs aren’t an option, you have the expertise to deploy, fine-tune, and optimize open-source models to achieve the mission objective.

 

 - Autonomous Problem Solving: You can take a high-level government requirement and translate it into a technical roadmap. You don't require constant oversight to identify the right tool for a job, whether it’s a specific vector database or a custom multimodal pipeline.

 

 - A "Generalist" Mindset: While you specialize in AI, you understand the full stack. You are as comfortable discussing embedding strategies as you are configuring AWS GovCloud infrastructure or debugging a FastAPI endpoint.
   
   
   
   


MUST-HAVES



 - Proven experience deploying Production RAG pipelines against real-world, messy datasets.

 - Deep expertise in Agentic system design (tool-use, multi-agent orchestration).

 - Strong Python engineering skills—writing clean, scalable, and maintainable code

 - Experience operating within AWS/GovCloud environments.
   
   
   
   


NICE-TO-HAVES



 - Experience fine-tuning NLP or object detection models.

 - Familiarity with LLM evaluation frameworks (hallucination detection, drift monitoring).

 - Knowledge of government security standards and working in different classification environments and on-prem

 - Security Clearance: Existing Secret/TS clearance or eligibility is a significant plus.
   
   
   
   


YOUR TECHNICAL TOOLKIT



 - Languages: Python (expert-level), SQL

 - LLM & Agentic Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar orchestration frameworks

 - RAG Stack: Retrieval with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector), graph databases (Neo4J), Elasticsearch, BM25, and Sentence-Transformers; NLP enrichment with spaCy, GLiNER, and Transformers; optimization using embedding models, reranking pipelines, and DSPy

 - Evaluation & Observability: RAGAS, DeepEval, Arize Phoenix, and synthetic annotations

 - Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, SageMaker, Bedrock, S3, Lambda, Docker, and FastAPI

 - Data Processing: Complex pipelines for unstructured and multimodal data, including PDFs, scanned documents, images, and audio.



Why You’ll Love It Here



You’ll be surrounded by smart, kind, low-ego people who genuinely enjoy building together. We invest in our team with company offsites, best-in-tech swag, and the tools you need to do your best work, wherever you’re based.

We support you holistically, not just at work. For full-time, US-based employees, that includes:

 - Health: Medical, dental, and vision coverage through Justworks, effective the 1st of the month following your start date. All medical plans include fertility coverage, plus access to One Medical, Talkspace (12 free therapy sessions a year), Kindbody, and Teladoc. If you waive medical coverage, we pay a $250/month allowance.

 - Financial: 401(k) with company match (100% of the first 3% you contribute, 50% of the next 2%), company-paid life insurance, and optional supplemental life, short- and long-term disability, accident, critical illness, and hospital coverage. FSA and HSA options available.

 - Equity: Stock options, so you share in what we’re building.

 - Time off: Flexible paid time off (unlimited), up to 80 hours of paid sick leave a year, 12 company holidays, and a company-wide winter break between Christmas and New Year’s.

 - Family: 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents, available after 6 months, plus up to 6 additional unpaid weeks.

 - Remote setup: A $500 home office stipend and a $75/month cell and internet stipend.

 - Team: Team and company offsites throughout the year.

We want you focused on building, growing, and staying energized for the long haul. If you’re excited about what we’re building, we’d love to meet you.

collect_global:jobs.ashbyhq.com:ashby--w.full_text:
THE ROLE

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Wonderful, you’ll turn complex enterprise workflows into AI agents that work in the real world.

You’ll operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer delivery. Embedding directly with enterprise teams, you’ll uncover how their operations actually run, identify where AI can create meaningful value, and build the systems that deliver it.

You’ll lead projects from initial discovery through production deployment, combining customer insight with hands-on engineering. After launch, you’ll measure real-world impact and keep iterating until the solution delivers meaningful results.

This role is for versatile engineers who enjoy combining deep technical work with customer context. You’re comfortable entering unfamiliar environments, asking incisive questions, and shipping practical solutions without waiting for a perfect specification.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Embed with customers to understand their workflows, constraints, and measures of success.

 - Turn loosely defined operational problems into clear technical plans and production systems.

 - Design and build AI agents that integrate with customer tools, data, and business processes.

 - Own deployments from prototype through launch, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

 - Test with real-world data, measure business outcomes, and iterate based on evidence.

 - Make pragmatic tradeoffs across architecture, reliability, speed, and user experience.

 - Partner closely with Wonderful’s Product and Engineering teams to improve the core platform.

 - Turn lessons from individual deployments into reusable tools, patterns, and best practices.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Minimum of 5+ years of experience in software engineering or technical problem-solving roles

 - Strong fundamentals in software design, system thinking

 - Communication skills in Japanese: Business to fluent-level (fluent to native-level is preferred) as the role will be working quite closely with stakeholders at traditional Japanese enterprise companies.

 - Communications skills in English: Business-level

 - Experience working across systems, integrations, and data flows

 - Clear communication skills and a strong ownership mindset: comfortable working directly with customers and owning ambiguous problems

 - Curiosity and interest in building AI-powered systems that work in practice

 - Proficiency in Software Development and Programming, with experience building production-grade applications.

 - Hands-on experience in Back-End Development, including APIs, databases, and cloud or distributed systems.

 - Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and their application in large-scale codebases.

 - Experience integrating AI or data-driven services into enterprise environments is a plus.

 - Ability to work directly with customers, gather requirements, and translate business needs into technical solutions.

 - Comfort with rapid prototyping, debugging in complex systems, and iterating in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

 - Eligibility to work in Japan


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in a forward-deployed, solutions engineering, consulting, or customer-facing technical role.

 - Experience building AI agents, workflow automation, or conversational systems.

 - Familiarity with LLM evaluation, observability, and reliability in production.

 - Experience deploying and improving systems in complex enterprise environments.

collect_global:jobs.ashbyhq.com:ashby--w.full_text:
THE ROLE

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Wonderful, you’ll turn complex enterprise workflows into AI agents that work in the real world.

You’ll operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer delivery. Embedding directly with enterprise teams, you’ll uncover how their operations actually run, identify where AI can create meaningful value, and build the systems that deliver it.

You’ll lead projects from initial discovery through production deployment, combining customer insight with hands-on engineering. After launch, you’ll measure real-world impact and keep iterating until the solution delivers meaningful results.

This role is for versatile engineers who enjoy combining deep technical work with customer context. You’re comfortable entering unfamiliar environments, asking incisive questions, and shipping practical solutions without waiting for a perfect specification.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Embed with customers to understand their workflows, constraints, and measures of success.

 - Turn loosely defined operational problems into clear technical plans and production systems.

 - Design and build AI agents that integrate with customer tools, data, and business processes.

 - Own deployments from prototype through launch, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

 - Test with real-world data, measure business outcomes, and iterate based on evidence.

 - Make pragmatic tradeoffs across architecture, reliability, speed, and user experience.

 - Partner closely with Wonderful’s Product and Engineering teams to improve the core platform.

 - Turn lessons from individual deployments into reusable tools, patterns, and best practices.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience building software or solving complex technical problems.

 - Strong foundations in software architecture, system design, and production engineering.

 - Experience working across APIs, integrations, data flows, and distributed systems.

 - The ability to bring structure and momentum to ambiguous problems.

 - Confidence working directly with customers, from operational teams to technical stakeholders.

 - Clear communication, sound judgment, and a strong sense of ownership.

 - Genuine curiosity about applied AI and its potential to transform how businesses operate.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in a forward-deployed, solutions engineering, consulting, or customer-facing technical role.

 - Experience building AI agents, workflow automation, or conversational systems.

 - Familiarity with LLM evaluation, observability, and reliability in production.

 - Experience deploying and improving systems in complex enterprise environments.

FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER, (F/M/X) SWITZERLAND - HYBRID




THE ROLE

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Wonderful, you’ll turn complex enterprise workflows into AI agents that work in the real world.

You’ll operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer delivery. Embedding directly with enterprise teams, you’ll uncover how their operations actually run, identify where AI can create meaningful value, and build the systems that deliver it.

You’ll lead projects from initial discovery through production deployment, combining customer insight with hands-on engineering. After launch, you’ll measure real-world impact and keep iterating until the solution delivers meaningful results.

This role is for versatile engineers who enjoy combining deep technical work with customer context. You’re comfortable entering unfamiliar environments, asking incisive questions, and shipping practical solutions without waiting for a perfect specification.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Embed with customers to understand their workflows, constraints, and measures of success.

 - Turn loosely defined operational problems into clear technical plans and production systems.

 - Design and build AI agents that integrate with customer tools, data, and business processes.

 - Own deployments from prototype through launch, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

 - Test with real-world data, measure business outcomes, and iterate based on evidence.

 - Make pragmatic tradeoffs across architecture, reliability, speed, and user experience.

 - Partner closely with Wonderful’s Product and Engineering teams to improve the core platform.

 - Turn lessons from individual deployments into reusable tools, patterns, and best practices.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience building software or solving complex technical problems.

 - Strong foundations in software architecture, system design, and production engineering.

 - Experience working across APIs, integrations, data flows, and distributed systems.

 - The ability to bring structure and momentum to ambiguous problems.

 - Confidence working directly with customers, from operational teams to technical stakeholders.

 - Clear communication, sound judgment, and a strong sense of ownership.

 - Good level of English and a preference for fluent German or French

 - Genuine curiosity about applied AI and its potential to transform how businesses operate.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in a forward-deployed, solutions engineering, consulting, or customer-facing technical role.

 - Experience building AI agents, workflow automation, or conversational systems.

 - Familiarity with LLM evaluation, observability, and reliability in production.

 - Experience deploying and improving systems in complex enterprise environments.



If this sounds like the kind of work you want to do, we should talk.

Apply here. Everyone will receive a response.

🚀 ABOUT WRITER

📐 About the role
We’re seeking a highly skilled fullstack software engineer to join our engineering team building advanced AI-driven agent systems that execute autonomous workflows, orchestrate multi-step tasks, and extend human capacity across enterprise applications. In this role, you’ll play a key part in designing, building, and scaling next-generation AI agents that integrate with enterprise data and services to solve real-world problems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to turn complex agent concepts into production-ready systems.

We are open to hiring for this role at multiple levels, with compensation ranges scaled to match your experience, expertise, and the scope of the role.


🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do

 - Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure agent-driven services and systems that autonomously accomplish tasks using modern AI frameworks.

 - Develop and enhance robust infrastructure and high-throughput APIs, focusing on core agent capabilities such as memory, communication channels, skills, intelligent decision logic, security and workflow management.

 - Integrate agent capabilities with backend services, data stores, vector databases, search/retrieval systems, and external APIs.

 - Collaborate with product managers, AI researchers, data engineers, and UX teams to translate high-level agent use cases into robust, production-ready software.

 - Ensure reliability, monitoring, and observability for all agent components (metrics, logging, CI/CD, fault tolerance).

 - Contribute to architectural design decisions and participate in rigorous code reviews to uphold quality and maintainability.



⭐️ What you need

 - 3+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong proficiency (3+ years) in Python in production environments

 - Proficiency in native agentic coding, demonstrated through the daily use of tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and other agentic coding platforms.

 - Demonstrated experience building distributed systems, microservices, or complex backend APIs that support AI/agent workflows.

 - Solid expertise with systems that integrate AI models, agent frameworks (e.g., Langraph, Agent Harness or platform-specific tooling), vector databases, and large context reasoning services.

 - Understanding of agent orchestration patterns, state management, and asynchronous workflows.

 - Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and operational engineering best practices.

 - Good grasp of performance optimization, testing frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines.

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a “connect + challenge + own” mindset.

 - Past work on AI agents that coordinate multi-step actions, reasoning, or autonomous decision-making loops.

 - Contributions to open-source agent toolkits or SDKs.

 - Experience with frontend technologies (React, TypeScript) for tooling around agent management interfaces.

🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance. 



Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com.



📐 About the role

Imagine stepping into a role where your code directly empowers the world's largest enterprises to safely adopt superintelligence. As a software engineer, generative ai at WRITER, you'll be at the forefront of expanding human capacity by building the secure, scalable foundation that allows our generative AI solutions to thrive in complex corporate environments. The impact of this work is massive – for example, in the consumer packaged goods industry alone, our AI adoption is driving 69% revenue increases and 72% cost reductions.

This role is designed for a well-rounded engineering generalist who leans heavily into generative AI while bringing a whole-systems mindset to architectural design. If you thrive on proactivity without red tape and love owning projects from proposal to deployment, you'll shape the future of AI and contribute to a product that’s changing how the world works. This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco, New York City, or London hubs. You'll report to an engineering director or a senior engineering manager.

We are open to hiring for this role at multiple levels, with compensation ranges scaled to match your experience, expertise, and the scope of the role.



🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do

 - Design and develop robust, secure, and scalable generative AI services and applications using Python and modern frameworks to drive enterprise-wide transformation

 - Build and optimize high-performance, low-latency APIs and microservices to integrate advanced AI models and sophisticated agentic workflows into our core platform

 - Act as a whole-systems thinker by making meaningful system design decisions and owning the architecture of core platform components from initial proposal through production deployment

 - Implement and maintain responsive user interfaces using technologies like React and TypeScript to deliver intuitive user experiences and bridge the gap between backend services and frontend enablement

 - Drive proactivity without red tape by clearly communicating changes, plans, and proposals to cross-functional teams and collaborating closely with product managers, data scientists, and DevOps engineers

 - Partner with DevOps teams to build continuous deployment, logging, and monitoring systems that ensure top-tier performance, security, and reliability across distributed workloads



⭐️ What you need

 - 3-5+ years of hands-on experience as a software engineer with a strong emphasis on Python development in production environments

 - Proven expertise in building and deploying generative AI applications, leveraging LLMs, vector databases like Pinecone, Weaviate, or pgvector, and modern open-source agentic frameworks

 - Practical experience with microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, and containerization with Docker and Kubernetes

 - Solid grasp of modern web technologies including FastAPI, Asyncio, database systems like PostgreSQL, and hands-on experience leveraging AI developer tooling like Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot to accelerate your engineering workflows

 - Exposure to enterprise architecture including practical experience implementing IAM, SSO, SAML, OAuth, OIDC, RBAC, robust security best practices, or building services for enterprise administration and billing systems

 - A Connect mindset that thrives in collaborative settings where you actively engage with cross-functional teams and mentor other engineers, a Challenge spirit that drives you to tackle complex technical hurdles and proactively suggest innovative improvements, and an Own attitude where you take full accountability for delivering high-quality, resilient, and scalable code from conception to production


🍩 Benefits & perks (US Full-time employees)

 - Generous PTO, plus company holidays

 - Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family

 - Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks)

 - Fertility and family planning support

 - Early-detection cancer testing through Galleri https://www.galleri.com/partner/writer

 - Flexible spending account and dependent FSA options

 - Health savings account for eligible plans with company contribution

 - Annual work-life stipends for:
   
   - Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc.
   
   - Learning and development stipend

 - Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites

 - Competitive compensation, company stock options and 401k

WRITER is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to diversity. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law. Under the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

By submitting your application on the application page,  you acknowledge and agree to WRITER's Global Candidate Privacy Notice https://writer.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice/.

About the Role

Every team at Xero has work that is slow, manual and error-prone, and the people doing it are often the ones best placed to make better decisions if they had the time. We're building agentic AI workflows that take that toil away, so our people can focus on the work that matters.

The Internal AI accelerator squad partners directly with Xero's enterprise and G&A functions, including HR, Legal and Finance. As Lead Engineer, you'll set the technical direction for the squad as it builds agents and workflows that the business can run itself. You'll stay hands-on in the hardest problems, coach the Senior Engineers around you, and be the senior technical voice with executive leaders across the business.

The Technical Challenges

The squad is early in its life, and the problems are as much about judgement as engineering. Four problems define the work:

 - A repeatable way to build agents: Define the patterns, frameworks and standards the squad uses so each new workflow is faster to build and safer to run than the last.

 - Agents the business trusts: Build agentic workflows that handle real work, with human review, guardrails and clear escalation, so business teams are comfortable relying on them.

 - Production, not prototypes: Set the bar for evals, observability and cost control, so every agent we ship is measurable and maintainable.

 - Discovery to handover: Take ambiguous business problems from senior leaders, shape them into work worth doing, and make sure what we deliver is something the business can own without us.

Examples of what the squad has already built include a triage agent for incoming support, a tax analysis agent, and an onboarding agent for every new joiner at Xero. Your job is to make sure the squad keeps building the right things, to a consistently high standard.

Impact

 - First 6 months: you'll understand the squad's platform, patterns and stakeholders. You'll be delivering hands-on alongside the team, and you'll have agreed the technical direction and delivery priorities for the squad with Callum. You'll have started coaching the Senior Engineers and be building relationships with executive stakeholders.

 - First 12 months: the squad's patterns and standards will be in use across its workflows, with evals and monitoring as the norm. You'll have led at least one significant agentic workflow into production with an executive partner, and the Senior Engineers around you will be growing in capability and autonomy.

Ownership

You'll own the technical direction of the squad's work, including architecture, standards and the quality bar for what ships. You'll lead the most complex and highest-stakes workflows end to end, from discovery with executive stakeholders through to production and handover. You'll coach and develop Senior Engineers, review their designs and help them grow, and you'll be accountable for outcomes beyond your own code. You'll work with Callum to prioritise the squad's roadmap, and you'll help shape how the squad works, including its use of AI-assisted development.

Who You'll Work With

 - Callum Ochkas, Head of Internal AI. 

 - Executive leaders across Xero's enterprise and G&A functions, including HR, Legal and Finance.

 - Senior Engineers in the Internal AI accelerator squad, who build and run agentic workflows across the business, and who you'll coach.

What You Bring

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and the depth to set technical direction for a squad, including architecture and trade-off decisions

 - Experience delivering agentic AI or LLM workflows into real production use, not just prototypes or personal projects

 - Experience owning relationships with senior non-technical stakeholders, up to executive level: understanding their pain points, building solutions, and handing them over so they run without you

 - Experience coaching and developing engineers, and raising the capability of a team through reviews, standards and mentoring

 - Experience designing agentic systems with tool use, retrieval, human-in-the-loop controls and guardrails, and evaluating them with measurable quality criteria

 - The ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to executives and build trust through delivery

 - Comfort using AI tools to improve how you and your team build, with judgement about when and how to validate their output

How We Work

We're bold in our vision and pragmatic in execution. We deliver useful improvements early and often, and we invest in AI to learn faster and focus effort on higher-value problems. Engineers stay accountable for what they ship, including quality and reliability. We use shared frameworks to avoid reinvention, leaving teams room to innovate. Leaders set context and priorities, and engineers help shape the solutions.

Where We Work

We offer a hybrid model that blends the flexibility of working from home with the collaboration of the office, including designated boost days in our modern office spaces.

Our Hiring Process

 1. TX phone screen (45 minutes): a conversation with your Talent Specialist about your background, motivations and the role.

 2. Round 1 (60 minutes): a technical conversation with the hiring team, where you'll walk through an agentic workflow you've delivered, from the business problem to production.

 3. Round 2 (60 minutes): a conversation focused on how you work with senior stakeholders and show up against Xero's values, including ownership, customer thinking and AI fluency.

 4. LEADership (60 minutes): real examples of how you lead, coach and influence, assessed against Xero's leadership principles.

Compensation & Total Rewards

At Xero, we value the impact and skills you bring to the team. We believe in a Total Package philosophy, ensuring your value is recognised through a holistic lens that includes base salary, performance incentives and world-class benefits.

The expected base salary range for this role is:

 - Vancouver: $210-250k

Individual pay is determined by various factors, including geography, level of experience, and the specific skills you bring to the role.

In addition to base pay, Xero's roles are eligible for the following:

 - Superannuation (Australia): 12% employer contribution.

 - Variable Pay: Permanent employees are eligible to participate in our annual equity programs, with an annual share allocation of 10% of base. You may also be eligible for performance-based incentives depending on your role level and company performance. 

 - Comprehensive Benefits: World-class health, wellness and retirement programs. Xero Perks https://careers.xero.com/inside-xero/benefits-wellbeing/ including wellbeing days, generous leave and dedicated professional development budgets.

If this sounds like a role you are interested in, hit the apply button!

collect_global:jobs.ashbyhq.com:ashby--x.full_text:
The role / impact

This senior engineering position owns a critical delivery stream on MyXero, the foundational platform that underpins every organisation and user record while managing hundreds of millions of daily requests. You will take ambiguous platform challenges from problem framing to durable architectural solutions, designing the specs, verification harnesses, and AI guardrails that enable software agents to handle implementation safely.

Your work directly enables the modernisation of a massive system into decoupled domain services without disrupting dependent products. By engineering automated verification loops and robust testing harnesses, you will ensure high reliability, mentor team members, and shape how our engineering practices operate safely with intelligent tools.

The team / how they connect

You will join the MyXero Ghostbusters squad within our Identity and Platform group, collaborating with engineers and product partners primarily based across New Zealand. The team operates with a written-first, remote-first philosophy, using design records, paired kick-offs, and blameless reviews to ensure every voice is heard and no one works in isolation. While delivery is high-tempo, the group maintains a supportive, open environment where technical curiosity and shared learning are core to daily routines.

Initially, you will focus on

 - Setting up an intentional local development harness with automated validation checks to safely handle production changes.

 - Refactoring legacy monolith endpoints and services built on .NET Framework, C#, and SQL Server towards modern APIs.

 - Developing automated verification loops, test simulation harnesses, and tools that reduce operational toil and human checks.

 - Building cloud agent tooling and collaborative workflows that support the evolution toward an automated development lifecycle.

Where and how you can work

This role is open to candidates based in New Zealand, offering a flexible remote-first setup with office access in Wellington or Auckland. Our working environment is structured around async communication and balanced collaboration.

Here are some of the things we are looking for

 - You bring deep full-stack or backend engineering experience with typed languages, ideally with exposure to C# and .NET environments.

 - Hands-on exploration with AI harnesses, coding agents, or automated verification pipelines in a personal or professional setting.

 - Practical familiarity with distributed systems architecture, API design, data modeling, and managing complex relational database migrations.

 - Proven capability in taking ambiguous technical problems from initial conception to production delivery.

 - Strong written communication skills to articulate system trade-offs clearly through design records and technical documentation.

 - A collaborative mindset with a drive to share learnings, uplift team capabilities, and contribute constructively to production support rotations.

Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

collect_global:jobs.ashbyhq.com:ashby--x.full_text:
The role / impact

Every team at Xero has work that is slow, manual and error prone and the people doing it are often the ones best placed to make better decisions if they had time. We're building agentic AI workflows/agents that take that toil away, so our people can focus on the work that matters. 

The internal AI accelerator squad partners directly with Xero's enterprise and G&A functions, including HR, Legal, Finance, Sales teams. As a Senior Engineer, you will work in a forward deployed way, sitting down with senior business leaders to understand their challenges, then designing, building and delivering agents and workflows that the business can run itself. You will own that work end to end, from the first conversation to a live system with real users. 

The technical challenges: 

The Squad is early in it's life and the problems are as much about judgement as engineering. Four problems define the work: 

 - Agents the business trusts: Build agentic workflows that handle real work, with human review, guardrails and clear escalation, so business teams are comfortable relying on them.

 - Discovery to delivery: Take an ambiguous business pain point, shape it into a problem worth solving, and deliver a working solution quickly, then iterate with the people using it.

 - Production, not prototypes: Design agents that are observable, evaluated and maintainable, with evals, monitoring and cost controls built in from the start.

 - Handover that sticks: Build so the business team can own and run the outcome without you in the loop, and so the next agent is faster to build than the last.

Examples of what the team have already built include a triage agent for incoming support at Xero, a tax analysis agent and an onboarding agent for new joiners here at Xero. Your job is to keep adding to that list, with each workflow sharper and more reusable than the one before. 

Impact: 

 - First 6 months: You'll understand the squad's platform, patterns and stakeholders. You'll be building alongside the team and have one agentic workflow in discovery or build with a senior business partner, with a clear scope and success measures agreed up front.

 - First 12 months: You'll have delivered at least one agentic workflow into production that a business team uses day to day, with evals and monitoring in place. You'll have handed it over so the business runs it, and your learnings will be feeding back into the squad's shared patterns and tooling. You will have also built a strong rapport with the business function you are working with, being the trusted technical expert for all things AI. 

What You Bring

 - Software engineering fundamentals, with experience designing and building reliable services and APIs

 - Experience delivering agentic AI or LLM workflows into real production use, not just prototypes or personal projects

 - Experience owning a relationship with senior non-technical stakeholders: understanding their pain point, building a solution, and handing it over so they run it without you

 - Experience designing agentic systems with tool use, retrieval, human-in-the-loop controls and guardrails, and evaluating them with measurable quality criteria

 - The ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical leaders and build trust through delivery

 - Comfort using AI tools to improve how you build, with judgement about when and how to validate their output

How We Work

We're bold in our vision and pragmatic in execution. We deliver useful improvements early and often, and we invest in AI to learn faster and focus effort on higher value problems. Engineers stay accountable for what they ship, including quality and reliability. We use shared frameworks to avoid reinvention, leaving teams room to innovate. Leaders set context and priorities, and engineers help shape the solutions.

Where we work: 

We offer a hybrid model that blends the flexibility of working from home with the collaboration of the office including designated boost days in our office spaces. 

Our hiring process: 

 1. TX phone screen (45 minutes): a conversation with your Talent Specialist about your background, motivations and the role.

 2. Round 1: (60 minutes) A technical conversation with Senior Engineers on this team, where you'll walk through an agentic workflow you've delivered, from the business problem to production and core engineering technical questions

 3. Round 2: (60 minutes) A conversation focused on how you work with stakeholders and show up against Xero's values, including ownership, customer thinking and AI fluency.

Compensation & Total Rewards

At Xero, we value the impact and skills you bring to the team. We believe in a Total Package philosophy, ensuring your value is recognised through a holistic lens that includes base salary, performance incentives and world-class benefits.

The expected base salary range for this role is:

 - Vancouver: $190,000 – $210,000 CAD

Individual pay is determined by various factors, including geography, level of experience, and the specific skills you bring to the role.

In addition to base pay, Xero's roles are eligible for the following:

 - Superannuation (Australia): 12% employer contribution.

 - Variable Pay: Permanent employees are eligible to participate in our annual equity programs, with an annual share allocation of 10% of base. You may also be eligible for performance-based incentives depending on your role level and company performance. [Confirm wording against current policy.]

 - Comprehensive Benefits: World-class health, wellness and retirement programs. Xero Perks https://careers.xero.com/inside-xero/benefits-wellbeing/ including wellbeing days, generous leave and dedicated professional development budgets.

If this sounds like the role you are looking for, hit the apply button!

collect_global:jobs.ashbyhq.com:ashby--x.full_text:
The role  

You will design, build and own the production systems behind Xero’s AI features: the services, pipelines and infrastructure that power LLM-driven and agentic experiences for millions of small businesses every day. This is a software engineering role. You’ll build and operate systems rather than train or tune models, and your architecture decisions will directly shape scale, cost, reliability and how fast our teams ship.

You don’t need a machine learning background. We’re looking for strong production engineers, ideally with experience building LLM or agentic systems, and ML depth can be learned on the team.

Beyond architecture, you’ll lift engineering capability across AI Products by setting standards, mentoring engineers and partnering across Xero to make data usable and systems dependable.

 

The team 

You’ll join AI Products, a diverse, globally distributed team of scientists, engineers, product managers and analysts within our broader Data & AI business.

Engineers here partner closely with Applied Scientists early on to build the interfaces and harnesses that take models into production. They then own the engineering and infrastructure of every ML and AI system shipped into production, from reliability and cost to scale. Together, this collaborative team reduces toil and delivers reliable, intelligent experiences for small businesses.


The team is currently working on

 - Production ML and AI engineering: Building and operating the platforms, services and practices that support traditional ML models, generative AI and agentic systems in production.

 - JAX (Just Ask Xero): Powering Xero's conversational GenAI assistant and evolving the underlying capabilities to support increasingly sophisticated, context-aware and agentic experiences.

 - Intelligent financial workflows: Developing capabilities such as Automated Bank Reconciliation and smart document capture, using ML and AI to match transactions, extract information from bills and receipts, and automate complex tasks.

 - XeroForce: Building the platform for AI-powered workflows, enabling agents to plan and execute complex tasks across Xero’s products and supporting reliable, reusable agentic experiences at scale.

 - End-to-end AI product experiences: Integrating AI into customer-facing experiences and product workflows, alongside the backend services, orchestration and infrastructure that make them work.

 

Where and how you can work 

Xero offers a flexible hybrid working model designed to blend the collaboration of office life with the autonomy of remote work. You will have access to our modern office spaces, with expectations around office days and collaborative 'boost days' aligned to help your team connect and ship great code effectively.


Here are some of the things we are looking for

 - A track record of designing, shipping and operating production-grade backend systems at scale

 - Experience building and operating production systems for LLM or agentic workloads (orchestration, tool use, evaluation, guardrails, latency and cost management)

 - Strong system design fundamentals and excellent coding in Python, or another language suited to web-scale services (Go, Java, Kotlin, TypeScript)

 - Experience with APIs and service design, cloud infrastructure (ideally AWS), CI/CD and observability, with a focus on latency, cost, reliability and SLOs

 - Experience running services in production, including on-call and incident response

 - Solid SQL and experience with large-scale data processing

 - Excellent communication, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to business and technical audiences

 - A coaching mindset and the ability to set engineering standards and mentor other engineers

Nice to have

 - Experience operationalizing ML or LLM workloads (inference serving, evaluation pipelines)

 - Familiarity with MLflow, PyTorch or TensorFlow, and data orchestration tools

 - Distributed processing experience (Spark, Dask)

 

Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

collect_global:jobs.ashbyhq.com:ashby--a.full_text:
ABOUT AI&

ai& is a new global AI technology company dedicated to meeting the world's growing demand for AI. Our vision is twofold: to serve as a premier AI lab specializing in localization, and to act as a global infrastructure and compute provider. We are building a unified, optimized global platform that integrates next-generation data centers and infrastructure, heterogeneous compute serving, and advanced model services. We believe that the most effective way to build and scale AI is to own the stack from top to bottom.

At ai&, we empower small teams with the autonomy needed to tackle significant challenges. Our approach is to deconstruct large problems into manageable components and solve complex issues collaboratively. We seek highly motivated, mission-driven individuals who demonstrate strong personal agency. We value curiosity as the foundation of talent, and we are looking for people eager to develop alongside our evolving technology and expanding business.

We are actively hiring worldwide, with presence in Tokyo, SF, Austin, and Toronto. We are more than happy to meet exceptional talent where they are.

Role overview

As a Member of Technical Staff in Applied and Agentic AI, you are building the agentic layer of ai&, the frameworks, workflows, and tooling that make it possible for our internal teams and our customers to deploy agents on top of ai& infrastructure with as little friction as possible.

One of the most important things ai& is building is the ability for anyone to harness AI agents without needing to understand the complexity underneath. That means the agentic layer needs to be powerful enough for sophisticated engineering teams and accessible enough for customers who simply want agents that work. You are responsible for both. You will integrate and extend the best open-source agentic frameworks available, build custom workflows that demonstrate the full capability of ai& infrastructure, and continuously raise the bar on how easy and reliable agent deployment feels.

This role sits at the intersection of applied ML engineering and product. You will work closely with the model, and platform teams to make sure the agentic layer reflects the best of what ai& can do at every level of the stack. At the same time you will be close to customers, understanding how they want to deploy agents and removing every obstacle between them and a working system. You will also contribute to the evaluation and QA process for the models we ship, ensuring that what reaches customers is stable, capable, and continuously improving.

The ideal candidate has built real agentic systems before, cares deeply about developer experience, and takes personal pride in making complex technology feel simple. If you want to work on the part of the stack that people actually touch, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

 - Agentic Framework Development Build and maintain the agentic frameworks that power agent deployment on ai& infrastructure. Integrate and extend open-source solutions including LangGraph, AutoGen, MCP, and others to create robust, production-ready tooling for internal teams and external customers.

 - Customer-Facing Deployment Tooling Make deploying agents on ai& as simple as possible. Build the interfaces, workflows, and abstractions that let customers go from idea to running agent with minimal friction.

 - Custom Agentic Workflows Design and build custom agentic workflows on top of the ai& inference product that demonstrate real capability and serve as the foundation for customer deployments.

 - Continuous Evaluation & Model QA Own the evaluation pipeline for inference models. Design evals that reflect real-world usage, catch regressions, and provide the signal needed to make confident decisions about model publishing and deployment.

 - Internal Enablement Build the agentic tooling and workflows that our own engineering teams use every day. Make ai& the best possible platform to build on, starting from the inside.

You may be a fit if you have the following skills

 - Agentic Framework Experience You have built production agentic systems. You understand orchestration, tool use, memory, multi-step planning, and how to make these systems reliable at scale.

 - Applied ML Fluency You know how to work with models in practice — prompting, chaining, evaluating, and iterating. You understand what it takes to turn a capable model into a dependable product.

 - Evaluation & Testing Rigor You have designed and maintained eval pipelines for AI systems and you know that evals are only useful if they reflect what users actually care about.

 - Developer Experience Instinct You think hard about what it feels like to build on a platform. You reduce complexity, write clean interfaces, and make the right patterns easy to follow.

 - Full-Stack Comfort Comfortable building across backend services and APIs. You can own a workflow end to end.

 - Relevant Tooling Strong command of Python. Familiarity with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar), evaluation tooling, and inference APIs.

 - Great Team Spirit A mission-driven approach to engineering, valuing clear communication, hands-on execution, and collective success over individual silos.

The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.


🎯 YOUR MAIN GOAL WILL BE TO BUILD AND OPERATE N8N’S SHARED CONTEXT INFRASTRUCTURE — OUR “COMPANY BRAIN” — SO BOTH PEOPLE AND AI AGENTS CAN RELIABLY ACCESS ACCURATE, WELL-STRUCTURED, AND APPROPRIATELY GOVERNED KNOWLEDGE ACROSS THE COMPANY.

To make that happen, you’ll shape how our knowledge is structured, contributed, accessed, and maintained as we build the context layer powering n8n’s agentic future:


DESIGN OUR INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE

 - Define the taxonomy, structure, contributor guidelines, and templates that turn fragmented company knowledge into reliable, reusable context.

 - Establish standards that make knowledge easy to navigate, maintain, and use without creating duplication or another layer of content sprawl.

 - Evolve these standards as our functions, knowledge sources, and agentic use cases grow.


ONBOARD & ENABLE TEAMS

 - Onboard functions to the company brain and train designated champions to structure and maintain their own knowledge over time.

 - Give non-technical contributors the guidance, templates, and support they need to contribute high-quality context independently.

 - Partner with the Internal AI Enablement Lead to develop a shared network of champions who help scale strong knowledge practices across n8n.


OPERATE OUR CONTEXT PLATFORM

 - Configure and operate ingestion from qualitative sources such as Slack, Gong, Drive, and Notion using our context platform’s tooling.

 - Own day-to-day platform configuration and basic troubleshooting, escalating genuine engineering challenges to our Automation team or vendor when needed.

 - Partner with IT, Security, and Legal to define requirements for how people and AI agents access sensitive company knowledge.


BUILD FOR LONG-TERM TRUST & REUSE

 - Keep content structures, contributor guidelines, and knowledge freshness current as n8n and the platform evolve.

 - Work with functions to ensure the company brain becomes a trusted source of context rather than another parallel knowledge repository.

 - Provide product feedback to our context platform vendor and anticipate shared context patterns and capabilities that future agents will need.


REQUIREMENTS


MUST-HAVES

 - 🗂️ Information architecture: You have proven experience designing structured content or knowledge programs at scale, including taxonomies, style guides, contributor guidelines, templates, or information architecture.

 - 🧠 Knowledge systems experience: You’ve worked hands-on with knowledge or context systems and understand what it takes to turn fragmented qualitative information into something others can reliably use.

 - ⚙️ SaaS platform fluency: You’re comfortable configuring and operating SaaS knowledge or context platforms, working with APIs and integrations, and independently troubleshooting basic issues.

 - 🎓 Stakeholder enablement: You have a track record of training non-technical stakeholders and enabling them to confidently maintain high-quality content themselves over the long term.

 - 🔐 Governance collaboration: You’re comfortable partnering with IT, Security, and Legal on access requirements and compliance-sensitive data flows without needing to own the underlying technical architecture.

 - ✍️ Communication: You have strong written and verbal communication skills and can set a clear quality bar for how company knowledge is structured, documented, and shared.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - 🤖 Context platforms: You’re familiar with Qontext.ai http://Qontext.ai or a comparable agent-context platform.

 - 🔌 MCP: You have experience with or a strong understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP).

 - 🏷️ Knowledge governance: You have a background in knowledge management, metadata, or data governance.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how an entire company’s knowledge becomes usable — not only by people, but by the AI agents increasingly working alongside them. You’ll build a capability we don’t have today and help establish the context layer that future agentic initiatives across n8n will depend on.

You’ll have real ownership over how company knowledge is structured, governed, and maintained, while working closely with teams across IT, Security, Legal, Data, and AI & Automation. You’ll also have the support of a strong technical team and vendor partner, so your focus can stay on creating a trusted, scalable knowledge system rather than building every piece of infrastructure from scratch.

As n8n grows, you’ll help turn fragmented knowledge into a shared company brain that teams can contribute to confidently and agents can depend on reliably.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the context layer for the future of automation.

Developer Productivity · AI Coding Agents · Developer Platform

Our ambition: an engineering organisation where humans and agents work as one continuously learning system, turning frontier AI capabilities and real-world feedback into more ambitious product development. We want n8n to be the reference for how this is done, without compromising quality, resilience or trust. Your main goal is to make that real.



This is a Staff individual contributor role in Developer Platform and the technical driving force behind ACDC (Agent-centric Development Cycle), our engineering-wide initiative for agentic development. Nobody has a playbook for this yet. You'll write ours.



You won't start from zero. Agents wired into Linear already automate around 80% of the development cycle on one of our developer platform projects, alongside pilots for insight, feature-flag and PR-review agents and a shared agent harness. Your job is to take this from promising experiments to the way n8n builds software.



This role is for someone who thinks about this problem constantly. You run agents all day, rebuild your own workflow every time the frontier moves, and have more ideas than time. 



You'll stay hands-on, building the first versions yourself, and shape how the work grows beyond one person.




WHAT YOU'LL DO


SET DIRECTION AND OWN THE OUTCOME

 - Identify where agentic development can make the greatest difference, using developer feedback, existing experiments and engineering performance data.

 - Set the strategy and priorities across agent execution, repository readiness, CI, security and developer workflows.

 - Make build, buy or pass decisions on tools and vendors, and own the cost and value trade-offs, including AI spend.

 - Make decisions where requirements are incomplete and the trade-offs between autonomy, reliability, security and review effort are still emerging.

 - Build alignment through technical proposals, clear decisions and working software, and report progress and impact to engineering leadership.


BUILD THE FOUNDATIONS

 - Design and build isolated execution environments where agents can work with the right access to code, tools and context, without exposing secrets or sensitive systems.

 - Own the safety model: which task categories agents may attempt, what they must never touch, and where human review is required, partnering with Security on sensitive areas like auth, billing, permissions and data handling.

 - Make n8n's monorepo agent-ready, working with Architecture and senior engineers on repo structure, testability, boundaries and the context agents need.


INTEGRATE AGENTS INTO HOW WE WORK

 - Build repeatable workflows that take Linear issues through agent execution, self-verification and review to merged PRs, across a growing range of task types.

 - Integrate agentic workflows with GitHub, CI, test infrastructure and code review, so the agentic path becomes the easiest path for engineers.

 - Extend the loop beyond coding: connect earlier signals like product research and customer requests, and later ones like production metrics, so agents contribute across the whole cycle.

 - Open it up beyond engineering, so PMs, designers and others can turn a well-defined issue into a reviewed, mergeable change.

 - Shape review practices, such as PR evidence that shows what changed, what ran, what risks remain and where human judgment is needed.


MEASURE WHAT WORKS

 - Build benchmarks from real historical engineering tasks to evaluate output quality, failure modes, review burden and production risk.

 - Define and track quality and adoption signals, such as reviewer acceptance rate, CI pass rate, rework rate and developer satisfaction.

 - Use data and feedback to change course, retire what doesn't work, and build trust across engineering.

 - 🤝 Direction without authority: You've set technical direction that multiple teams followed, through proposals, design reviews and credibility with senior engineers across Platform, Product Engineering, AI, Security and Architecture.

 - 🔐 Safety judgment: You've made real decisions on permissions, secrets, sandboxing, sensitive code paths and human-in-the-loop review, and can explain the trade-offs.

 - 📊 Measurement that drives decisions: You've built evaluations, benchmarks or quality metrics and used them to change course or retire things that didn't work. You care about outcomes, not lines of AI-generated code.

 - ✍️ Writing that changes decisions: Your technical proposals and documentation have shifted what teams did.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - 📦 TypeScript monorepos: You have worked in a large TypeScript, Node.js or JavaScript monorepo.

 - ⚙️ Developer platforms: You have experience with GitHub Actions, Linear, test infrastructure, preview environments or internal developer platforms.

 - 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Growing a team: You've mentored engineers or helped shape a new team as an initiative grew beyond one person.

 - 🌍 Open-source communities: You have contributed to open-source or source-available projects with active developer communities.

 - 🏢 B2B SaaS context: You understand environments where reliability, permissions, data handling and customer trust are central.

 - 🔗 Workflow automation: You're familiar with workflow automation, integration platforms, AI orchestration or developer-facing products.




WHY JOIN US?

At n8n, you'll define how autonomous AI agents become a trusted part of engineering inside one of Europe's fastest-growing AI-native infrastructure companies. Your work will shape the platform foundations, safety model, evaluation framework and developer workflows that decide whether agents can contribute meaningfully to production engineering without lowering the quality bar.

You'll join a remote-first team with high autonomy, high visibility and a strong builder mindset. Because this is a first-of-its-kind role, you'll set direction, influence engineering culture, and create learnings that may inform both our internal engineering and n8n's product thinking.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now, and help us build the future of automation.

ABOUT US


Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.


For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.


AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.


At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.


We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.


Check out our principles https://principles.telli.com/ to see how we work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This role is for engineers who care about velocity and solving real customer problems. You won't just ship code; you will own projects end-to-end, make core product and technical decisions, and shape the trajectory of this company.

Our philosophy is to push the frontier models to the limits of what is possible - and to achieve that, we need your help.

We are a small team working across:

 - harness engineering

 - applied AI products

 - realtime audio

 - distributed systems

 
 


WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

 

Voice AI

Voice AI is one of the hardest technical challenges we have right now. We need to ensure that the voice AI we deliver is fast, reliable, and high-quality.

Topics that we are currently working on:

 - No-infra RAG using SQLite artifacts downloaded for each call.

 - Racing LLMs to use the fastest one at any given moment.

 - Shadow-test new transcribers on real calls before switching production traffic.

 - Make Voice agents respond faster without reducing quality.

 - Make every bad call easy to understand and debug.

 

Multi-channel agents

Currently, our agents are primarily voice agents, but we will extend their capabilities to be able to handle any channel.

 - Build an agent that is able to call someone, follow up on WhatsApp, wait three days for a reply, send an email, and continue exactly where it stopped.

 - Let agents choose the right channel instead of forcing every interaction into a phone call.

 - Share memory, tools, and state across realtime and asynchronous conversations.

 

Call scheduler

We have to develop a distributed call scheduler that will manage load across our voice orchestration. It has to handle many race conditions and distribute the load evenly across customers while applying additional rules.

 - Start large call batches without letting one customer consume all available capacity.

 - Prevent duplicate calls even when workers crash, restart, or race each other.

 - Handle time zones, calling windows, retries, provider limits, and changing capacity.

 - Keep the system moving when individual calls, workers, or providers fail.

 

Agent memory

Our agents have multiple interactions with customers, so we need to ensure they can reason throughout the whole flow.

Topics we have to develop:

 - What information should be persisted in memory?

 - How should the voice agent access memory?

 - Should agents share memory?

 

Charlie

Charlie is our AI coworker for building, configuring, debugging, and improving agents.

 - Enable Charlie to use every capability in our product without building one-off tools.

 - Make Charlie available through the app, Slack, Teams, ChatGPT, and Claude.

 - Make every action token-efficient, traceable, and easy to understand.

 - Enable Charlie to use customer-context to make effective proactive suggestion on improving agents
   
    

Analytics & Dashboard

We want Charlie to replace dashboards full of charts with direct, useful answers.

 - Enable Charlie to turn plain-language goals into business KPIs.

 - Give Charlie the context to explain metric changes and trace them to exact calls.

 - Enable Charlie to surface trends, regressions, and opportunities automatically.
   
    

Workflows

Voice agents need to do real work, not just have conversations.

 - Enable Charlie to connect agents to CRMs, calendars, WhatsApp, email, and customer systems.

 - Give Charlie the ability to build workflows that wait, retry, and resume.

 - Enable Charlie to inspect failures, explain their cause, and suggest a fix.

 
 


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

We believe that today, engineers must not only know how to ship code but also ensure they work on the right problems. These are the core skills we look for in the interview process:

 - You have built and owned distributed systems in production.

 - You have strong software fundamentals and learn unfamiliar domains quickly.

 - You are eager to act, biased towards action, and want to get your hands dirty.

 - You want to figure things out on your own rather than waiting for people to tell you what to do.

 - You don’t take what people say as given; you want to understand the problems yourself and challenge the status quo.

 - You are excited about agentic coding, but can do it with awareness ensuring quality

 - You are a team player: You optimize for the engineering organization’s output, not your individual output.

 
 


OUR TECH STACK

 - Voice and backend: Python, uv, FastAPI, LiveKit, TypeScript, Bun, Node.js, Fastify

 - Frontend: React, Vite, TanStack

 - Data and workflows: PostgreSQL, Redis, Temporal, SQLite

 - Observability: OpenTelemetry, Honeycomb, Better Stack

 - Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Azure, Cloudflare, Render, Cerebrium, Modal

 
 


WHAT MAY NOT MAKE YOU A GOOD FIT

 - you prefer a remote-first environment

 - you want to be told exactly what to do

 - you mostly care about the tech, not business outcomes

 - you want to work 9-5

 


PERKS

 - very competitive pay + equity package

 - access to any (AI) tools

 - large token budget

 - free dinners if you stay late

 - urban sports

 - relocation support if you don’t live in Berlin

1、2027届硕士及以上应届毕业生，计算机、人工智能、软件工程等相关专业；
2、扎实的工程基础：精通Python，熟悉Golang/Java/TypeScript至少一种，具备良好的软件工程素养与系统设计能力；
